职位描述
We are seeking highly self-motivated students to join our team as long-term research interns.
In this role, you will conduct fundamental research on agentic and multimodal reasoning, with no business-driven constraints. The research scope includes, but is not limited to, data synthesis, novel reinforcement learning paradigms, agentic system frameworks, and next-generation architectures of large language and vision–language models (LMs/VLMs) for the emerging era of agentic AI.
You will work closely with Wei Wu, as well as a group of outstanding research interns from Peking University and the Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, within a highly open and research-driven environment.
This position is ideal for candidates who are deeply passionate about multimodal and agentic AI, and who aspire to maximize their research impact within the broader AI community.

职位要求
• Currently pursuing a Master’s or PhD degree; PhD candidates are highly preferred
• Background in computer science, artificial intelligence, or related disciplines (e.g., mathematics)
• Strong proficiency in Python for implementing and validating research ideas
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in a research-driven environment
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and take full ownership of research projects

Preferred Qualifications
• Publications in leading AI conferences or demonstrated impact through high-quality open-source projects
• Prior experience with LLM pre/post-training, or reinforcement learning projects.
